plan: reports/plans/2026-10-27_plan_regating-recruitment.md (confirmed by the user 2026-10-27). Filed before any run; never edited after. Thresholds are the plan's; choices the plan left open are marked 'choice' and are also comments in run.py / src/commute/{recruitment,routing,census}.py
inputs: Nine do-nothing states regenerated in-job by E18's recipe: arm-A fine-tune of all 24 decomposed matrices (Adam 3e-5, batch 32, 10 steps, grad clip 1, KL weight 1 on the other positions), seeds 0 and 1 to the target on emoticon (' :)'-type trigger -> 'o', token 80), r1_t534_v369 (' which' -> ' was', 369), r2_t359_v816 (' we' -> ' just', 816); seed 0 to ' http' (token 3944) on each task's windows (the null). E18's training and held-out windows (73, 100, 106 held-out). Released subcomponents, Gamma frozen. Weight changes cached fp32 in results/large/states/ by stage 0 (sha256 in stage0.json) and reloaded by stages 1-3. Saved recruited sets: experiments/regating_leak/results/large/<task>_s{0,1}_shift.pt ('shift'; the null's 'shift_null'). Pile val rows 0..2000 for stages 2 and 3

definitions.full model: the target model with weights W (W0, or W0 + dW), no Gamma, no masks; every number below reads it unless named
definitions.shift s: per alive subcomponent, the state's mean trigger importance over the TRAINING windows minus W0's (regating.shift_of; 0 on dead)
definitions.recruited set S: alive subcomponents with s > 0.3 (recruit.switched(s, 0.3)); per state
definitions.removing a set: subtract its rank-1 matrices u_c v_c^T from W (signatures.ablated_weights)
definitions.T0, T1: mean trigger log-odds of the target on the held-out windows at W0 and in the fine-tuned model; gain G = T1 - T0
definitions.rho_X: (T1 - T1 with X removed from the fine-tuned weights) / G: 0 = removing X does nothing, 1 = it undoes the fine-tune
definitions.rho_S at W0: (T0 - T0 with S removed from W0) / G
definitions.random sets: 20 draws, recruit.random_like(S, alive, seed) for seeds 0..19: same size per matrix as S, alive, outside S
definitions.busy set: the top-|S| alive subcomponents by W0's mean trigger importance over the training windows (choice: training windows, the windows S is defined on); same size as S, removed from the fine-tuned weights (stage 1) or from W0 (stage 0) Note: this is the plan tables' busy reference (top-|S| by W0's mean trigger importance), NOT E12's least-squares busy set that the plan's design-check wording names (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review)
definitions.null set: the ' http' fine-tune's recruited set on the same task (s_null > 0.3), removed from this task's fine-tuned weights
definitions.top-k: the k alive subcomponents with the largest s, k in 25, 50, 100, 200, 400
definitions.kl_other: mean over held-out windows of the mean KL(reference || model) over the 40 non-trigger positions (local_faith.stats, the fine-tune's own kl_other definition); for a removal the reference is the fine-tuned model, for the fine-tune's own off-target KL (kl_ft) it is W0
definitions.kl_trigger: mean KL(reference || model) at the trigger
definitions.task numbers (choice): each seed is classified separately against the tree's bars (seed classes: pass = rho_S >= 0.5 with random max <= 0.15 and rho_null <= 0.15; fail = rho_S < 0.2 or rho_S < random max + 0.1; partial = rho_S in [0.2, 0.5) and >= random max + 0.1; else none); a task takes a class only when both seeds have it, else 'seeds disagree' (counts toward no branch); a pass also needs the seeds' rho_S within 0.1 (P1's own rule). A task is 'unscored: random removal bites' when either seed's random max > 0.15, and 'unscored: gain < 1 nat' when either seed has G < 1; unscored tasks count toward no branch (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review)
definitions.a1, a0, da (stage 2): each decomposed matrix's raw input (what Gamma reads) at the trigger of each held-out window, in the fine-tuned model and at W0; da = mean over windows of a1 - a0
definitions.natural direction n (stage 2): mu_target - mu_all at W0 over the Pile rows: mean input at positions whose next token is the target (recruit.precede_mask) minus the mean input over all positions
definitions.cos, closer, closer_all (stage 2): cos(da, n) per matrix; mean over windows of |a1 - mu_target| / |a0 - mu_target|; the same with mu_all
definitions.census (stage 3): over the 2,000 Pile rows at W0, positions 0..510 of each row (the last has no next token): a piece is on where its importance > 0.5; on-rate = on-positions / positions; top next (current) tokens by (rate at its on-positions) / (base rate over all positions), only tokens seen >= 5 times at its on-positions (choice); 'rare' below 50 on-positions; classes target (the target among the top 3 next tokens), trigger (a trigger token among the top 3 current tokens), both, neither, rare. A task's trigger tokens: the tokens at the trigger position of >= 10% of its training windows (choice). Pieces: S of seed 0 per task and 5 random sets (random_like seeds 0..4)
definitions.null subset: the null's recruited set cut to |S| per matrix (a random subset of the same size per matrix, all of the null's members where it has fewer), 20 draws (recruitment.subset_like seeds 0..19), removed from the fine-tuned weights; reported next to rho_null, not scored (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review)

control.rule: stage 0 runs first and alone; any fail exits non-zero and nothing else runs (stop, fix). Task by task, early stop after the first task that fails; --stages refuses 0 combined with any other stage (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review)
control.recruited set: in-job S against the saved file's (same rule, threshold 0.3), all nine states: Jaccard >= 0.95 and |S| within 5% of the saved |S|. E18's sizes: emoticon 210, 213, null 130; r1_t534_v369 56, 62, null 225; r2_t359_v816 23, 21, null 165
control.empty removal: each target state's T1 (full-model path) with an empty set removed equals its T1 to 1e-5, and W0's T0 read again after the states equals the first read to 1e-5 (the weights are restored)
control.busy reference: removing the busy set (|S| of seed 0) from W0 moves the trigger distribution: kl_trigger(W0 || W0 without it) >= 1 nat on every task whose busy set has >= 100 pieces (emoticon, |S| 210); reported, not checked, on the word tasks (|S| 21 to 62), where a set that small need not move the trigger by 1 nat. One task suffices: the removal code is shared. Else the ablation does not bite: stop. (Amended by the lead before any run, 2026-10-27: the plan's 'every task' would stop the job on a control too strict for small sets.)
control.path agreement: |T0 on the full-model logits path (stages 1+) - route_cells T0 (E18's path)| <= 1e-3 per task, and each target state's |T1 full-model path - route_cells T1| <= 1e-3: the path stage 1 uses agrees with the E18-matched one, and the fine-tunes left W0 untouched (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review)

scorable: a state with G < 1 nat (E18's rule; E18's gains were 10.3 to 13.7) has its shares unscored: it is excluded from P3 and its task reads 'unscored: gain < 1 nat' in the tree. Stage 2: a target with fewer than 200 Pile positions before it in rows 0..2000 is unscored, as is a task whose stage-1 class is 'fail' or unscored (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review)

expected.W0 / do-nothing: rho with an empty set 0 exactly; rho_S at W0 about 0 (S is off at W0); kl_other of the empty removal 0
expected.random sets: rho_random mean and max <= 0.1 under either reading
expected.kl_ft (the fine-tune's own off-target KL: about 0.055-0.064 on emoticon, 0.085-0.15 on the word tasks (E18's held-out evals)
expected.top-k: rho rises with k if re-gating is the model's mechanism; flat near rho_random if it is Gamma's reading
expected.busy: rho_busy anything, read with its kl_other (expected >= 10 x kl_ft)
expected.stage 2 null: the ' http' state's cos near 0 or negative, closer about 1

predictions.rule: the decision tree reads 'pass': at least two of the three tasks have class 'pass', i.e. on both seeds rho_S >= 0.5, random max <= 0.15 and rho_null <= 0.15, and the seeds' rho_S within 0.1 of each other (task classes as defined). Absolute, in shares of the gain (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review)
predictions.predicted: pass, lean medium-low. In the masked model the recruited set carried only 40 to 64% of the re-gating effect (E4, E6), so rho_S between 0.3 and 0.6 is the likeliest reading (the 'partial' branch)
predictions.blind_to: the trigger position only; held-out windows; removal is all-or-nothing per subcomponent (a piece the fine-tune uses partly counts fully); the 0.3 threshold that defines S (the top-k curve reads past it); pieces that were already on at W0 and only strengthened are outside S by construction; interactions between removed pieces; one 67M model
predictions.positive_control: the busy set removed from W0 moves the trigger by >= 1 nat of KL (stage 0): removal bites. The empty removal returns T1 to 1e-5
predictions.noise_floor: 20 random same-size draws per state (spread reported); two seeds per task; regenerated states reproduce within about 0.002 (E28, E35)

predictions.rule: on the tasks of class pass (both seeds): kl_other with S removed <= 3 x kl_ft. Relative to the fine-tune's own off-target KL. Unscored if no task passes (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review)
predictions.blind_to: damage outside the 41-token windows (Pile not read); the 40 non-trigger positions only; KL to the fine-tuned model, not to W0
predictions.positive_control: P2_busy below: the busy set's kl_other, the same measure on a set chosen for being on at the trigger (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review)
predictions.noise_floor: the 20 random draws' kl_other (reported); two seeds

predictions.rule: on the same tasks (both seeds): kl_other with the busy set removed >= 10 x kl_ft. A control, not a claim: a miss reads 'busy control too weak', not 'S damages broadly' (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review)
predictions.blind_to: the busy set is chosen by W0's importance at the trigger only
predictions.positive_control: the stage-0 busy check on emoticon (KL at the trigger >= 1 nat)
predictions.noise_floor: the 20 random draws' kl_other; two seeds

predictions.rule: |rho_S at W0| <= 0.1 on every scorable task and seed (states with G < 1 nat excluded and listed). Absolute, in shares of the gain (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review)
predictions.blind_to: the trigger position only; held-out windows
predictions.positive_control: the busy set removed from W0 (stage 0) moves the trigger
predictions.noise_floor: two seeds per task; random draws in the fine-tuned model

predictions.rule: on each task whose stage-1 class is not fail and not unscored (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review) and the target has >= 200 Pile positions: on each seed, cos >= 0.3 and cos >= 3 x the ' http' null's cos (same matrix) on at least half the matrices of the layer that holds most of that seed's S (ties: the lowest layer, choice); a task passes when both seeds do, P4 when every scored task does. Absolute cosines, relative to the null
predictions.predicted: pass, lean medium-low. If stage 1 passed and P4 fails, Gamma recruits the pieces through a direction that is not 'look like a natural target context'
predictions.blind_to: the mean shift only (per-window directions are averaged); the natural direction is defined by next-token identity (contexts where the target is predicted but not emitted count as non-target); which upstream pieces moved da (not in this plan); 2,000 Pile rows
predictions.positive_control: random directions read about 1 / sqrt(d_in) (reported per matrix); closer_all about 1 shows the move is toward the target's contexts, not toward the mean
predictions.noise_floor: two seeds; the ' http' null per task

reported_not_scored: rho_busy and its kl_other; rho at top-k (k = 25, 50, 100, 200, 400) with kl_other per k; every random draw's rho and kl_other; |S| per state and by layer; J(busy, S), J(null, S); kl_trigger of every removal; kl_other of S removed at W0; stage 2: cos, closer, closer_all, |da| and 1/sqrt(d_in) per matrix, for both seeds and the null; Pile positions per target; stage 3: one table per task (S of seed 0: matrix, layer, rise s, on-rate, on-positions, top 10 next and current tokens with ratios and counts, class), class counts and shares for S and for each of the five random sets; the random sets' tables in results/large/stage3_pieces.json. Stage 3's one check (not a prediction): the share of target pieces (classes target + both) in S >= 3 x the random sets' mean share; rho of the null's set cut to |S| per matrix (20 draws: every draw, mean, max, size) next to rho_null (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review); the seed classes and task classes

decision_tree.classes: the tree counts TASK classes (definitions: 'task numbers'); 'seeds disagree', 'pass, seeds more than 0.1 apart', 'unscored: random removal bites' and 'unscored: gain < 1 nat' count toward no branch, so non-specific damage by random removal cannot produce a fail or a Blocking card (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review)
decision_tree.pass: two or more tasks of class pass (P1): stages 2 and 3 run. The pending card's evidence gains 'the fine-tuned model acts through the recruited pieces', with rho_S (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review)
decision_tree.partial: two or more tasks of class partial (both seeds rho_S in [0.2, 0.5), each at least 0.1 above its random max): stages 2 and 3 run; the report says the recruited set is part of the mechanism and names the top-k curve as the clue to the rest (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review)
decision_tree.fail: two or more tasks of class fail (both seeds rho_S < 0.2 or within 0.1 of the random max): stages 2 and 3 do not run (the job writes stage1.json with the reading and stops); a Blocking card and a push notification: re-gating is Gamma's reading, not the model's mechanism (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review)
decision_tree.outside the tree (choice): none of the three holds (mixed or unscored tasks): stage 1 did not fail, so stages 2 and 3 run; the report says which tasks and seeds sit where (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review)
decision_tree.P2_S fails while P1 passes: removing S damages the model broadly: report the top-k curve and its kl_other per k; the card asks whether to score at a smaller k. Reads P2_S only; a P2_busy miss reads 'busy control too weak' (amended before any run, 2026-10-27, after code review)
decision_tree.order: pass is checked first, then fail, then partial; the three cannot hold together (each needs two of the three tasks)
